$description: Props per component, generated from the registry source by scripts/props.mjs; do not edit.

props.name: source
props.description: The robot, sensor or system that raised it.

props.name: time
props.description: When it was raised, already formatted by the app: "14:02:31".

props.name: title
props.description: What happened and where: "Collision risk · Hall B".

props.name: active
props.description: The condition is still present.

props.name: acknowledged
props.description: An operator has acknowledged it.

props.name: shelvedUntil
props.description: Shelved by an operator until this time, already formatted ("15:30"). A shelved alarm is out of the live list and silent; the app clears this field when the time comes, and the alarm returns. Critical alarms cannot be shelved.

props.name: suppressed
props.description: Suppressed by design: the app's logic says it does not apply now (a docked robot's "not moving"). Counted, not shown.

props.name: outOfService
props.description: Out of service: taken off for maintenance by an authorised person. Counted, not shown.

props.name: raisedAt
props.description: When it was raised, in ms since the epoch. Needed only for flood detection.

props.name: onAcknowledge
props.description: Shown while unacknowledged. Without it the alarm is read-only (for viewers).

props.name: onShelve
props.description: Shows "Shelve" (not on critical alarms). The app asks how long, then sets `shelvedUntil`.

props.name: onUnshelve
props.description: Shows "Unshelve" on a shelved alarm.

props.name: action
props.description: The corrective action, e.g. "Open camera".

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<AlarmLabels> & { title?: string; summary?: (active: number, unacknowledged: number) => string; none?: string; shelvedGroup?: (count: number) => string; hidden?: (suppressed: number, outOfService: number) => string; flood?: (count: number, minutes: number) => string; lowGroup?: (count: number) => string; many?: (count: number) => string; }

props.name: flood
props.description: More than `count` alarms raised within `minutes` is a flood (ISA-18.2: over 10 in 10 minutes per operator). The list says so, keeps critical and high on top and folds low alarms into one row. Needs `raisedAt` on the alarms.

props.name: now
props.description: The current time in ms, for flood detection. Defaults to the clock; pass it to make a story or test stable.

props.name: feedback
props.description: Buzz and sound for a new critical or high alarm (the `feedback` patterns). On by default; turn off where the list is a record, not a live feed.

props.name: size
props.description: Bytes.

props.name: progress
props.description: 0–100 while uploading.

props.name: leaving
props.description: Removed from the list: plays the exit, then calls onLeft. Pair with usePresenceList.

props.name: debounce
props.description: Call `onQueryChange` only once the typing has paused this long (ms). The text box itself never waits; clearing never waits.

props.name: filter
props.description: Filter options by the typed text. Turn off when the server filters.

props.name: showTrigger
props.description: A chevron that opens the full list.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child element (e.g. a link) with button styles.

props.name: loading
props.description: Disables the button (no double submit) and shows a spinner after 300 ms, so quick actions never flash. It keeps its look: busy is not unavailable.
